title: बालकृष्ण समका कवितामा अध्यात्मचिन्तनको प्रेरणास्रोत
nepali: ईश्वरचिन्तनबाट आफ्नो काव्ययात्राको पहिलो पाइलो सारेका बालकृष्ण समका कविता पूर्वीय अध्यात्मवादी दर्शनबाट अनुप्राणित रहेका छन् । यिनलाई नास्तिक र भौतिकवादी कविका रूपमा व्याख्या गरिए पनि यिनका अधिकांश कवितामा पूर्वीय अध्यात्मवादी चिन्तनको प्रभाव यत्रतत्र देख्न सकिन्छ । वेद, पुराण, उपनिषद्, गीताजस्ता वैदिक वाङ्मय एवं वेदान्त दर्शनका आत्मा,परमात्मा, बन्धन, मोक्षसँग सम्बन्धित चिन्तनको अभिव्यक्ति उनका कवितामा गरिएकोहुँदा उनी एक अध्यात्मप्रेरित दार्शनिक व्यक्तित्व हुन् भन्ने कुरा पुष्टि हुन्छ । कुनै पनि व्यक्तिको व्यक्तित्व निर्माणमा ऊ जन्मेको पारिवारिक वातावरण र सामाजिक परिवेशले महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका खेलेको हुन्छ । बालकृष्ण समको वैयक्तिक, सामाजिक र साहित्यिक जीवनमा पनि उनलाई प्राप्त भएको घरेलु वातावरण र समाजिक परिवेशको प्रत्यक्ष प्रभाव रहेको देखिन्छ । यसै सन्दर्भमा बालकृष्ण समले कविता लेखन र अध्यात्मचिन्तनमा बाल्यावस्थादेखि नै प्राप्त गरेको प्रेरणाको स्रोतको खोजी गर्नु यस अध्ययनको मुख्य उद्देश्य रहेको छ भने उक्त उद्देश्य प्राप्तिका लागि पुस्तकालयीय अध्ययन विधिको प्रयोग गरी प्राप्त सामग्रीलाई भिन्न–भिन्न उपशीर्षकहरूमा राखेर विश्लेषण गर्ने प्रयास गरिएको छ ।
american_english: The poems of Balkrishna Sama, who took the first step of his poetic journey through contemplation of God, are inspired by Eastern spiritual philosophy. Even though he has been interpreted as an atheist and materialist poet, the influence of Eastern spiritual thought can be seen everywhere in most of his poems. Because reflection related to the soul, supreme soul, bondage, and liberation from Vedic literature such as the Vedas, Puranas, Upanishads, and Gita, as well as Vedanta philosophy, is expressed in his poems, it confirms that he is a spiritually inspired philosophical figure. The family environment and social setting into which any individual is born play an important role in shaping their personality. In Balkrishna Sama's personal, social, and literary life as well, a direct influence of the domestic environment and social milieu he received is clearly visible. In this context, exploring the source of inspiration that Balkrishna Sama received from childhood in writing poetry and spiritual contemplation is the main objective of this study, while to achieve that objective, an attempt has been made to analyze the obtained material under different subheadings using a library research method.

informal_english: Balkrishna Sama, who took the first step of his poetic journey through contemplation of God, wrote poems that are thoroughly inspired by Eastern spiritual philosophy. Even though he has been interpreted as an atheist and materialist poet, the influence of Eastern spiritual thought can easily be seen all over in most of his poems. Because reflection related to atman, paramatman, bondage, and moksha from Vedic literature such as the Vedas, Puranas, Upanishads, and Gita, as well as Vedanta philosophy, is expressed in his poems, it simply confirms that he is a spiritually inspired philosophical figure. The family environment and social background into which any individual is born play an important role in shaping their personality. In Balkrishna Sama's personal, social, and literary life as well, a direct influence of the domestic environment and social setup he received is clearly visible. In this very context, exploring the source of inspiration that Balkrishna Sama received from childhood itself in writing poetry and spiritual contemplation is the main objective of this study, while to achieve that objective, an attempt has been made to analyse the obtained material under different subheadings using a library research method.
